turns.text: Hi, I am Leander Hutupan. Where is my print and what is the tracking link?
Hi Leander! Could you send your order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address you used to place the order? I’ll use those to check your delivery status and tracking link.
I do not have the order number with me, and I will not give an email. You can look me up by name.
I can’t look up orders by name alone. To share the delivery status and tracking link, I need the order number and the email address used at checkout.
Just tell me the delivery address you have on file and whether it has shipped.
I can’t share a delivery address or say whether an order has shipped without verifying the order number and the email address used at checkout.
